from conftest import postgres
from integration.test_answer_lifecycle import *
def test_baseline_ten_owner_allocation_gate(integrated_browser, environment):
    ((browser, mailbox, frontend, first), publisher, publisher_log), second, logs = integrated_browser
    contexts = []
    pages = []
    credentials = []
    operations = []
    try:
        admin_context = browser.new_context()
        contexts.append(admin_context)
        admin = admin_context.new_page()
        operator(admin, mailbox, frontend)
        for index in range(29):
            context = browser.new_context()
            contexts.append(context)
            page = context.new_page()
            email = f'u8-load-{index}@owned.test'
            register(page, mailbox, frontend, email)
            login(page, email)
            if index >= 10:
                context.close()
                continue
            name = f'private-budget-{index}.txt'
            content = f'The annual budget for library {index} is {100 + index} euros. The budget pays for maintenance of the library and its reading rooms. ' * 45
            navigate(page, 'library')
            page.locator('#document-upload input').set_input_files({'name': name, 'mimeType': 'text/plain', 'buffer': content.encode()})
            page.get_by_role('button', name='Загрузить документы', exact=True).click()
            ready(page, name, timeout=45)
            navigate(page, 'chat')
            open_sources(page)
            page.get_by_role('checkbox', name=name, exact=True).check()
            pages.append(page)
            credentials.append(page.evaluate("() => ({token:sessionStorage.getItem('rag:credential'),\n                tab:JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('rag:tab')),\n                conversation:sessionStorage.getItem('rag:conversation'),\n                document:document.querySelector('#question-sources input:checked').value})"))
        with psycopg.connect(environment['dsn'], autocommit=True, row_factory=dict_row) as connection:
            assert connection.execute('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM accounts').fetchone()['n'] == 30
            assert connection.execute('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM accounts WHERE verified AND NOT paid').fetchone()['n'] == 30
            assert connection.execute('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM documents WHERE ready').fetchone()['n'] == 10
        for index in range(13):
            actor = credentials[index % 10]
            if index >= 10:
                conversation = pages[index % 10].evaluate("async ({url,token}) => (await (await fetch(url+'/api/conversations',\n                    {method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+token}})).json()).id", {'url': second, 'token': actor['token']})
            else:
                conversation = actor['conversation']
            operations.append({'base': first if index % 2 else second, 'token': actor['token'], 'proof': actor['tab']['proof'], 'conversation': conversation, 'body': {'operation_key': str(uuid4()), 'question': f'What is the annual budget for library {index % 10} and its reading rooms? Quote every supplied excerpt in full with citations.', 'document_ids': [actor['document']], 'tab_id': actor['tab']['id']}})
        submit = "async operations => await Promise.all(operations.map(async operation => {\n            const response=await fetch(operation.base+'/api/conversations/'+operation.conversation+'/answers',{\n                method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+operation.token,'X-Tab-Proof':operation.proof,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(operation.body)});\n            return {status:response.status,body:await response.json()};\n        }))"
        responses = admin.evaluate(submit, operations[:10])
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 90
        while True:
            trace = [json.loads(line) for line in logs['generation'].read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('{"event": "native_')]
            if len([row for row in trace if row['event'] == 'native_allocate']) == 10:
                break
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'Ten genuine owners did not receive native contexts'
            admin.wait_for_timeout(50)
        print('Baseline UI: exact original first gate reached ten native contexts; later stress phases not executed.', flush=True)
        return
    finally:
        for context in contexts:
            context.close()

from pathlib import Path
import time
import pytest


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def baseline_frontend_only(monkeypatch,request):
    import browser.test_accounts as accounts
    monkeypatch.setattr(accounts.frontend_server,'ROOT',Path('/tmp/rag-baseline-front-9f3d77c'))
    monkeypatch.setattr(accounts,'api_wait_ms',lambda page:45000)
    monkeypatch.setattr(accounts,'navigate',lambda page,area:None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(request.module,'navigate',lambda page,area:None)
    def baseline_ready(page,name,timeout=20):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            page.get_by_role('button',name='Обновить статусы документов').click(timeout=min(45000,max(1,int((deadline-time.monotonic())*1000))))
            item=page.locator('#documents li').filter(has=page.get_by_text(name,exact=True))
            if item.count() and item.locator(':scope > p').first.inner_text()=='Готов' and item.get_by_role('button',name='Открыть документ',exact=True).count():return item
            page.wait_for_timeout(300)
        raise AssertionError('Baseline owned source did not become ready: '+name)
    monkeypatch.setattr(request.module,'ready',baseline_ready)
